name: aura_apply_count reads 1 after a direct Unit::AddAura fixture
contract: aura_apply_count (AuraApplyCounter, hooked off UnitScript::OnAuraApply) must count an aura application made outside the cast pipeline, such as set_aura's own Unit::AddAura call, the same way the Divine Strikes trigger entry relies on it counting AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp's player->AddAura(803372, target).

steps.label: no application recorded before the fixture aura is applied
Unit::AddAura through set_aura is recorded exactly once
